messages:
ana (PM): Quick sketch for ctx-routing v3 rollout. Goal: phased canary + small A/B quality checks + soft QPS caps + model-level fallback chains.
vik (eng): Nice. Need explicit slice progression, circuit breaker windows, and fallback ordering.
nana (PM): sorry typo 1 ana. Proposed slices: 0.5% eu (48h), 5% eu+na (72h), 20% global (5d) with 10% of the 20% as A/B (new scoring vs v2). Aim to finish ramp after 2w if stable.
mike (sre): Call out SLO thresholds that auto-trigger fallback vs manual rollback. Automation needs precise numbers.
nana (PM): SLOs: p95 latency increase <= +25ms (goal p95 <=150ms), error-rate delta <= +0.5% abs, eval-quality drop <= 1.5 points, cost delta <= +10% per 1k tokens. If two of these breach over two contiguous windows => automated model-level fallback for affected slice.
elaine (data): For the A/B: daily evals: automated eval-score, 200 random human blind ratings/day, avg completion length, downstream conversion proxy. I'll own dashboards and daily signal.
vik (eng): Flag: ff.ctx-routing-v3. Fallback chain: 1) tenant-dedicated pool, 2) quantized redwood-lite-q4, 3) cached-prefix degrade. Circuit-breaker: 60s sliding window; trip if p95>200ms or error>1% for that slice.
nana (PM): Add exempt_customers list (manual opt-in for some enterprise tenants). Those will follow a manual rollout path and be excluded from auto-fallback. Legal & CS need signoff.
mike (sre): On-call + product lead + eng owner can flip global kill-switch. Bot pages if fallback persists >5m. Auto-fallback toggles slice flag -> fallback=true; pages after 5m.
sre-bot: NOTE: canary ff.ctx-routing-v3 deployed at 1712550520 for slice=0.5% (eu). Dash: /dashboards/routing-v3-canary
vik (eng): Sample flag config (to be stored in Launchpad):
```json
{
  "flag":"ff.ctx-routing-v3",
  "stages":[{"pct":0.5,"regions":["eu"],"duration_hours":48},{"pct":5,"regions":["eu","na"],"duration_hours":72},{"pct":20,"regions":["eu","na","apac"],"duration_hours":120}],
  "ab_allocation":{"within_stage_pct":10,"control":"v2"},
  "fallback_policy":"route:model=redwood-lite-q4;notify=oncall,prod;sla_circuit_ms=200",
  "exempt_customers":["tenant-alpha","tenant-beta"],
  "soft_qps_cap":"5rps_per_1k_users_in_slice"
}
```
elaine (data): Add eval hooks: sample_rate=1/1000 requests; persist minimal hashes only for privacy; blind human grading rolling window. Also tag events with rollout_id & ab_group.
vik (eng): Dev tasks: 1) flag gating + rollout automation, 2) routing policy unit tests, 3) canary infra: shadowing + A/B joins, 4) automated rollback script. PRs incoming with links.
mike (sre): Ops runbook (short):
- If bot pages -> check p95, errors, cost delta for slice.
- If single SLO breach -> set ff.ctx-routing-v3 fallback for that slice (auto).
- If two SLO breaches in two windows -> escalate, pause rollout, ops + prod decision.
- Manual rollback: /ops rollback ff.ctx-routing-v3 -> v2 (requires 2 approvers).
nana (PM): Pre-20% checklist: CS docs, internal FAQ, opt-in form for exempt list, billing sign-off, SLA notes.
vik (eng): Telemetry: rollout_id, slice_pct, ab_group, fallback_reason, telemetry_version so we can slice easily.
elaine (data): Timeline: dashboards + eval script by EOD tomorrow. If canary clean after 48h, approve next stage.
mike (sre): Recommend soft QPS caps per slice to avoid noisy neighbors: default 5rps per 1k users in-slice, adjustable. Also suggest warmup ramp over first 10 minutes of stage.
nana (PM): I'll draft the formal playbook and post to the ship doc and ping CS/legal for exempt approvals. Thanks team :rocket:
